chapter: Emmett Hardy and the river towns
title: Hardy's band replaces Sharky at the Taunty social club; the free-for-all
summary: Hardy's band is hired at a social club after Sharky's firing and a free-for-all breaks out, leaving Hazel hit by a bottle.
